# Requested audio

Every narration clip the app needs. **No audio in this project is generated: no text-to-speech and no voice models run in the repo or the pipeline.** Each clip is recorded or produced outside the repo and dropped into the folder named in its request. Until a story's clips arrive, the app shows its text without narration.

**Each story has one file per language, inside the folder its clips go into** (`content/stories/<id>/audio/<lang>/REQUESTED_AUDIO.md`, linked below). Each is written in its own language, for that language's narrator, and is complete on its own: the narrator's voice, how to deliver, the technical spec, who's in the story, and every clip with its exact script and direction. This file is only the index.

This file is generated. To change a request, edit the narrators in `content/style/voice.json`, the words in the story's `story/<lang>.json`, names and personalities in its `bible.json` (the first language) or its `translations/<lang>.json` (the others), the lines at the end of every story in `content/app/narration.json`, then run `cd tools && uv run story assets`. Run it again after delivering files, and the ⬜ entries turn ✅. Delivered clips aren't in git: `uv run story originals push` keeps them in Firebase Storage.

## The end of every story

The lines the narrator says at the end of every story. They're the same for every story, so they're recorded once per language, not per story: `the-end` as "The End" rises on the ending screen, then `more-endings` while the story has endings left to find, or `all-endings` once every one is found. Their scripts and directions, in every language, are in `content/app/narration.json`. **Each language has one file, inside the folder its clips go into** (`content/app/audio/<lang>/REQUESTED_AUDIO.md`, linked below), written in that language for its narrator.

| Language | `the-end` | `more-endings` | `all-endings` | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [English (`en`)](content/app/audio/en/REQUESTED_AUDIO.md) | 0/1 | 0/1 | 0/1 | **0/3** |
| [Latin American Spanish (`es`)](content/app/audio/es/REQUESTED_AUDIO.md) | 1/1 | 1/1 | 1/1 | **3/3** |

## Narrators

One narrator per language, the same for every story in it. Each is described in its own language in `content/style/voice.json`, and in full at the top of every file in that language.

| Language | Narrator | Status |
|---|---|---|
| English (`en`) | Warm storyteller | proposed, not yet approved |
| Latin American Spanish (`es`) | Voz cálida de cuentacuentos | proposed, not yet approved |

Every narrator keeps the same pace, in words per minute: ages 3–5: about 115, ages 4–7: about 140, ages 7–10: about 155. The app paces a story without narration at the same speed.
